top_choice_rationale: P004 is a single, bounded, experimentally verified discovery: the independent 1995 observations by Moodera and Miyazaki of large room-temperature tunnel magnetoresistance, reproduced for three decades and distinct in mechanism from the 2007 GMR prize. Dropping Parkin leaves two names I can tie to the original experiment, so the citation avoids the unresolved MgO-barrier priority question. I rank P002 next as a well-replicated discovery, though its pairing mechanism is still open, then P003 and P001, where the credit split or the programme-versus-discovery question troubles me. P005 is strong in science but I cannot be sure of the names, and a prize is still preferable to no award.
